posts.text: Valid point. Discretion is the better partnof valour. Nobody ever told RCA about that precept! These claims of 20000 stores in US, creating a political party etc. may be public statements of a happy go lucky person but they do spook serious investors. I suspect they will continue to shrink in valuations despite stellar numbers because of this overhang. No clear resolution is in sight on the management question or even the unrestrained growth aspirations.
